F7: the head's argmax and the draft's top probability over many blocks a row (fork fbb8bfa)
The verify head's argmax and the draft's top probability over many blocks a row.

The draft head's top probability ran row_top_prob, one 1024-thread block a row over the 40,525-token draft head
(and the head's greedy pick, sampler_greedy_kernel, one block a row on sm_80 to sm_89).  argmax_rows scans a row
in up to 128 blocks (4,096 logits each), the row's last block merging their picks (the larger value, on equality
the lower index: the one-block kernel's order); row_top_prob_split computes row_top_prob's 32 warps' sums in 8
blocks, the row's last block adding them in order.  Both keep their counters and partials in per-row slots of one
scratch.  Bitwise: the new verify_parity test checks them against sample_tokens' greedy pick and row_top_prob (ties,
NaN, -inf, 1-8 rows on one scratch).

CUDA only: argmax_rows is used on sm_80 to sm_89 (sm_90+ keeps sample_tokens' cluster kernel); row_top_prob_split on
every CUDA card; HIP and the cards below sm_80 keep the old kernels (STRATA_MULTI_BLOCK_ARGMAX=0 turns both off).
Ported from eddoursul's fork, commit fbb8bfa (MIT).

Co-authored-by: Eddoursul <git@eddoursul.win>
